about: Our team of technicians are up to date on the latest automotive technology, and have professional, hands-on experience working with both foreign and domestic vehicles. We use the most current diagnostic equipment available, meaning that we can quickly uncover the problem and begin working on the solution.

Looking for an affordable alternative to the high auto repair service pricing at the local dealership? Grand Auto Master can help. With very experienced mechanics who receive ongoing training in automotive technology and auto repair services, we're proud to be able to offer you dealership quality knowledge and experience without dealership pricing!
